outputs.explanation: This is a sequence conservation logo (sequence type), not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Bar/mean±SEM plot of inhibition zone with individual gray dots overlaid for each biological replicate, as stated in the caption and visible in the panel.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot of averages.
Mean±SEM fluorescence intensity plot with individual yellow open-circle data points shown for each measured cell/sample.
Mean±SEM fluorescence intensity plot with individual blue open-circle data points shown for each measured cell/sample.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM microscopy images of individual cells, not a quantitative averaged plot.
Mean±SEM plot of number of clusters per cell with individual gray dots shown for each cell.
Mean±SEM plot of cluster sizes with individual gray dots shown for each cluster.
Mean±SEM plot of molecule percentage into clusters with individual gray dots shown for each cell.
